#!/bin/bash
# Reminder: Follow up with Maya if she's not there by 6:30 PM
# Scheduled to fire at 18:30 UTC

TARGET_HOUR=18
TARGET_MIN=30

now=$(date +%s)
today=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
target=$(date -d "$today $TARGET_HOUR:$TARGET_MIN:00" +%s 2>/dev/null)

# If target time has already passed today, schedule for tomorrow
if [ "$now" -ge "$target" ]; then
  target=$(date -d "$today $TARGET_HOUR:$TARGET_MIN:00 + 1 day" +%s 2>/dev/null)
fi

wait_seconds=$((target - now))

echo "⏰ Reminder scheduled. Sleeping for $wait_seconds seconds (until $(date -d @$target))..."
sleep "$wait_seconds"

echo ""
echo "============================================="
echo "🔔 REMINDER: Follow up with Maya if she's not there by 6:30 PM."
echo "============================================="
echo ""
